text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day. At an event called the Vegetable 
Fest, Furioso was tasked with promoting 
Funabashi's vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right away, she sought advice from Hokko 
Tarumae, who had plenty of experience 
promoting local regions... however—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: W-Wah... it's so crisp...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...It's... bitter... sweet.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, your smile is twitching! It's 
totally different from just a moment 
ago...!?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You were giving such a fluent food review 
just now— Don't tell me... you're bad with 
bok choy!?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Guh!? N-no! Bok choy is a delicious 
vegetable...! I'm the one to blame 
here...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I understand that a bittersweet taste 
has its charm. It's just... the more I 
chew on it, the more bitter it seems to 
get...
choice_data_list: Looks like they're really bad at it...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I am utterly ashamed of myself. I 
can't even face the bok choy like this.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Under these conditions, a superficial 
PR push would actually be disrespectful. 
Please leave me out of it this time—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please wait, Furioso-san! Are you really 
okay with that?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Both you and that bok choy hail from 
Funabashi... Raised in the same land, you 
are fellow hometown comrades."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
People raised in the same beloved hometown 
are bound to understand each other. You, 
of all people, should surely be able to 
love it...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Right, what on earth am I doing... Just 
because I'm not fond of it, trying to 
leave out something from my own 
hometown...!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Tarumae-san. I swear I will 
love bok choy, and promote it straight 
from my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Things you see often become more 
likable... I heard that somewhere before.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"...Let us spend today together, Bok Choy. 
It is all so that we may become 
closer...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, will it even work if I hate the 
taste? ...No, I just have to wait and 
see...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Bok choy, can you see it? This starry 
sky. We're connected to distant Funabashi 
under this very same sky. —Good night.
choice_data_list:
...Make sure to let it rest in the fridge, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
As we spend time together, I feel like I'm 
slowly coming to understand you...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I know we'll get along great. After all, 
we're both from Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal. ......

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...It's bitter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like that was no good. Maybe 
having her promote a different vegetable 
for a change of pace would work, but...
choice_data_list: I want to ask about komatsuna.
Keep pushing with the bok choy...!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Spinach...? Um, understood...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Did you know that Chiba Prefecture once 
ranked #1 in spinach production, and 
Funabashi City contributed greatly to that 
glorious achievement?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...That's too bad, but let's push what 
we're good at this time! Time to rework 
our strategy!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Bok choy, someday you will too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps fueled by this frustration, the 
subsequent PR campaign proceeded with 
tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Komatsuna... I'm sure many of you enjoy it 
as a popular leafy green, but—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"If you drink alcohol, Trainer, how about 
a komatsuna highball? I can't drink yet, 
but it's a specialty gourmet of 
Funabashi."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to tailor your PR to whoever 
you're facing is powerful... It's 
unfortunate, but let's make good use of 
this strength this time...!"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Bok choy, someday you will too...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps fueled by this frustration, the 
subsequent PR campaign proceeded with 
tremendous momentum.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You've worked so hard to get this far. I 
told them that they might be able to 
overcome it with just a little more 
effort.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Right. I didn't want to give up either.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Bok choy... I swear I will learn to love 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every day after that, Furioso kept eating 
bok choy. Her dedication became famous 
around the academy, and whether it 
actually ended up promoting it or not... 
who can say?
